List curated fields

Source: R/fields.R
mds_fields.Rd

Returns the curated dictionary of MI Social fields: the technical field name used by the API, a readable Portuguese label, the unit and how the value is stored in the API.

Usage

mds_fields(theme = NULL)

Arguments

theme

Optional theme id (see mds_themes()). NULL (default) returns all themes.

Value

A tibble with columns theme, field, label, unit, nature, nature_basis and storage_type.

Details

The API itself has no data dictionary. Labels are a reading of the technical names, checked against the published values; units are what is counted (Famílias, Pessoas, R$, %...). storage_type is the Solr type given by the suffix (_i integer, _l long, _f float, _d double, _s string) and says nothing about the unit. Any other field published by the API (see mds_api_fields()) can still be requested by name in mds_data().

nature says how a field may be aggregated:

natureAcross municipalitiesAcross months
estoque (count at the month)sumdo not sum
fluxo (amount in the month)sumsum
fluxo anual (one value a year, in December)sumone value a year
acumulado (running total)sumdo not sum
taxa, média, índicedo not sumdo not sum

nature_basis says where the classification comes from: medido (the monthly series was inspected: a running total only grows, an amount of the month varies and restarts), mesmo grupo de um campo medido, or rótulo e unidade (inferred from the label and unit, not inspected).

Examples

mds_fields("bpc_suas")
#> # A tibble: 10 × 7
#>    theme    field                 label   unit  nature nature_basis storage_type
#>    <chr>    <chr>                 <chr>   <chr> <chr>  <chr>        <chr>       
#>  1 bpc_suas bpc_ben_i             Benefi… Pess… estoq… rótulo e un… integer     
#>  2 bpc_suas bpc_idoso_ben_i       Benefi… Pess… estoq… rótulo e un… integer     
#>  3 bpc_suas bpc_pcd_ben_i         Benefi… Pess… estoq… rótulo e un… integer     
#>  4 bpc_suas bpc_val_f             Valor … R$    fluxo  medido       float       
#>  5 bpc_suas bpc_idoso_val_f       Valor … R$    fluxo  rótulo e un… float       
#>  6 bpc_suas bpc_pcd_val_f         Valor … R$    fluxo  rótulo e un… float       
#>  7 bpc_suas bpc_idoso_val_medio_f Valor … R$    média  rótulo e un… float       
#>  8 bpc_suas bpc_pcd_val_medio_f   Valor … R$    média  rótulo e un… float       
#>  9 bpc_suas cadsuas_qtd_cras_i    Unidad… Unid… estoq… rótulo e un… integer     
#> 10 bpc_suas cadsuas_qtd_creas_i   Unidad… Unid… estoq… rótulo e un… integer
